name: netlocalgroup2
help: List local group members with detailed info (SID, type) for BOFHound.
long_help: Enhanced version of netlocalgroup that outputs member details including SID and member type (User, Group, WellKnownGroup, etc.). Optimized for BOFHound ingestion. If no group is specified, queries: Remote Desktop Users, Distributed COM Users, Remote Management Users, and Administrators.

arguments.name: group
arguments.desc: Group name to query (if not specified, queries RDP Users, DCOM Users, Remote Mgmt Users, and Administrators)
